description: This file is a JavaScript plugin for Leaflet that adds drawing and editing tools for maps, including classes and methods for creating, editing, and deleting map layers such as polylines, polygons, circles, rectangles, and markers.

classes.name: L.Draw.Feature
classes.description: Base class for drawing features on the map, handles enabling/disabling drawing modes and event management.

classes.name: L.Draw.Polyline
classes.description: Class for drawing polylines, manages vertices, guides, and shape validation.

classes.name: L.Draw.Polygon
classes.description: Extends Polyline for drawing polygons, includes area calculation and shape validation.

classes.name: L.Draw.SimpleShape
classes.description: Base class for simple shape drawing (rectangle, circle), manages shape creation and events.

classes.name: L.Draw.Rectangle
classes.description: Class for drawing rectangles, manages bounds and shape creation.

classes.name: L.Draw.Circle
classes.description: Class for drawing circles, manages radius and shape creation.

classes.name: L.Draw.Marker
classes.description: Class for placing markers on the map.

classes.name: L.Edit.Poly
classes.description: Handler for editing polygon/polyline vertices, including moving, adding, and removing points.

classes.name: L.Edit.SimpleShape
classes.description: Handler for editing simple shapes like rectangles and circles, including resizing and moving.

classes.name: L.Edit.Rectangle
classes.description: Handler for editing rectangles, including moving corners and bounds.

classes.name: L.Edit.Circle
classes.description: Handler for editing circles, including radius and position.

classes.name: L.Edit.Toolbar
classes.description: Toolbar for editing features, including save, cancel, and delete actions.

classes.name: L.Edit.Toolbar.Edit
classes.description: Handler for editing existing features, supports moving and vertex editing.

classes.name: L.Edit.Toolbar.Delete
classes.description: Handler for deleting features from the map.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor for setting up drawing or editing handlers with map and options.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Activates the handler, sets up event listeners and UI.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Deactivates the handler, removes event listeners and UI.

methods.name: _fireCreatedEvent
methods.description: Fires event when a shape or marker is created.

methods.name: _enableLayerEdit
methods.description: Enables editing for a specific layer.

methods.name: _disableLayerEdit
methods.description: Disables editing for a specific layer.

methods.name: revertLayers
methods.description: Reverts layers to their original state before editing.
